judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J.:— The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the order has already been complied with.

2. In view of the above, nothing remains to be adjudicated in this contempt petition. Accordingly, the contempt petition is closed. No costs.
